F1 recoverable uncertainty: history-publication.json no longer vetoes later publication. A publisher holding the exclusive writer lock discards abandoned active/reserve records without converting reserve into capacity, preserves the earlier generic publication sequence, and commits scoped, dirty, skipped, xfail, failed, and older outcomes normally while returning selection-disabled. Failed outcomes durably upsert obligations. Only a result strictly newer than the generic marker that satisfies the existing clean-full contract and has a complete nonempty inventory whose every outcome is passed may clear generic uncertainty. Cleanup occurs only after the SQLite transaction, baseline publication, obligation reconciliation, quota validation, and state validation commit. A deterministic barrier proves the recovering run and cleared obligation are durable while the marker still disables selection, before marker removal enables selection. No recovery command or public surface was added; strict skipped/xfail and capacity-marker behavior remain intact.

F2 truthful capacity: history-capacity-reserve.json is now writer-only preallocation. Read helpers do not read it or infer capacity from it. Abandoned reserve state is removed under the writer lock, while an abandoned publication remains selection-disabled. On observed SQLITE_FULL/quota failure, os.replace promotes the preallocated reserve to history-capacity.json before either active/publication marker is removed. Capacity is then reported from the durable marker at every post-promotion cleanup boundary. The reader rechecks durable capacity across publication disappearance, remains mutation-free and lock-free, and a healthy writer reports no marker limitation at every active/publication/reserve creation and cleanup boundary. Marker payload schemas remain bounded and non-sensitive.

Secure-by-spec negative contracts: identity/authentication are N/A because this repair adds no credentials, remote actor, or external identity. Authorization and tenancy remain enforced by the existing validated private DomainPaths/checkout boundary; no normal-domain fallback or cross-checkout state was added. Input handling retains exact marker schemas and requires an authoritative complete nonempty all-passed inventory for recovery. State coverage includes interrupted and stale publishers, later ordinary/failing commits, strictly ordered recovery, publication/reserve creation, capacity promotion, and cleanup interleavings. Exposure remains limited to version/code/sequence and PID/birth marker allowlists; no argv, environment, output, path, or test identifier is stored in markers. Availability uses the existing bounded writer deadline and finite capacity recovery; reserve files cannot manufacture exhaustion. Dependencies remain local filesystem, SQLite, stdlib, and the existing psutil dependency; no network, cloud, API, model, dependency, CI, or migration boundary changed. Bandit, Gitleaks, pip-audit, and property/fuzz gates are not configured in this checkout and were not installed or claimed.

The healthy boundary test already passed and is retained as regression evidence, not claimed as a RED defect.
